tasks.short: Direct workers on machine setup and use

steps.what: Give directions to other workers regarding machine set-up and use and clarify their questions

tasks.design: Retain direct explanation and situational clarification, supported by controlled instructions in {DOCS}. A retrieved document does not establish that another worker understands the actual setup.
tasks.previous_blocker: Directions must reflect the machine, job and worker's current understanding.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest covers records and calculations rather than replacement of live worker direction.
tasks.still_hard: A question may reveal a mismatch between instructions and actual conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize misunderstanding and obtain qualified clarification when needed.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of production and operating workers

evidence.claim: Live machine-use direction depends on contextual communication; no local software time saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is giving directions, excluding engineering instruction creation and workers' machine setup or production labour.

Responsible engineering or supervision supplies current instructions before use; workers provide questions during s1 before direction closes. Source checking and clarification remain retained. No free understood-instruction or setup-approved flag is assumed.
Use existing controlled instructions and direct communication first. No new reporting task, tool or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual delegated direction authority and instruction control
research_questions: Which worker questions expose an instruction-to-machine mismatch?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Direct communication remains human work without an invented document-drafting share.

steps.what: Select, position, align and bolt jigs, fixtures, guides or stops using instruments and tools

tasks.design: Retain physical fixture selection, alignment and fastening with the setter. Controlled setup references in {DOCS} support the task; no new robotic mounting system or automatic fixture-suitability judgement is established.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual fit and alignment require physical measurement and manipulation.
tasks.enabler_now: The supplied records and arithmetic products do not perform this physical task.
tasks.still_hard: Wear, tolerances and actual machine conditions can differ from the nominal setup.
tasks.human_edge: Notice an unexpected physical condition and resolve it before treating the setup as complete.
tasks.altitude: Physical setup and measurement retain their time.

reach.learn: How physical tolerances affect setup interpretation

evidence.claim: Fixture selection and mounting require physical work; the digest establishes no applicable automatic mounting capability or local labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary is selecting and mounting existing setup components, excluding original fixture design and production operation.

Responsible engineering supplies specifications before s1; the setter produces measurements and observations during s1 before accepting the physical fit. All inspection and manipulation remain counted. No free correct-fixture, aligned-position or fastening-complete flag exists.
Use existing instructions, instruments and tools first. No new system, delegated measurement or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual fixture variation and existing mechanized assistance
research_questions: Which setup discrepancies require further technical clarification rather than nominal specification lookup?

already_counted.description: Physical selection, measurement, alignment and mounting

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Physical setup remains retained; report automation is not transferred to mounting labour.

tasks.short: Observe soldering or brazing process conditions

steps.what: Observe meters, gauges and machine operations and judge whether processes meet applicable specifications
inputs: actual gauge readings and machine behavior

tasks.design: Retain observation of the actual operation and interpretation against controlled specifications in {DOCS}. Existing machine indications may support attention, but production data recording alone does not establish process conformity or remove observation time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Visible process behavior and gauge context may contain information beyond numerical thresholds.
tasks.enabler_now: Monitoring products collect values, while the supplied digest retains weld and coating judgement with people.
tasks.still_hard: A nominal reading can coexist with a process concern that requires qualified interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Notice inconsistencies between instruments and the observed operation.
tasks.altitude: Process observation retains its full time pending evidence of a validated substitute.

reach.role: inspector, tester, sorter, sampler or weigher
reach.task: Clarify a suspected process conformity concern
reach.learn: How process evidence differs from a final quality conclusion

evidence.claim: MPDV HYDRA X collects quantities and machine states through controls or manual entry; this does not establish automatic conformity judgement for the described soldering or brazing process.
Retaining live observation rather than claiming a sensor-only saving is an E1 design choice pending local evidence.

assumptions: Boundary is observing and interpreting process conditions, excluding separate production reporting, final product inspection and machine adjustment.

Machines provide indications during s1 and responsible engineering supplies applicable specifications before use. The operator reads, checks context and clarifies uncertainty within retained time; no free conforming-process or reliable-sensor flag is assumed. Unclear indications require manual investigation through existing arrangements.
Existing native indications and controlled references come first. No new sensor feed, extra reading-capture duty or maintenance is proposed.
unknowns: Actual observation coverage and validated process monitoring limits
research_questions: Which conformity concerns cannot be established from recorded numerical readings alone?

already_counted.description: Live instrument and process observation with contextual interpretation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Observation and interpretation retain their time; recording capability does not establish observation savings.

steps.what: Devise fixtures or jigs to hold the actual parts under applicable production constraints
Build fixtures or jigs and check actual fit with the intended parts

tasks.design: Retain fixture conception and physical construction with the setter, supported by existing references in {DOCS}. No separate repetitive drawing or calculation workload is established for this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Holding real parts requires a feasible concept and a physical fit check.
tasks.enabler_now: The supplied reporting and gear-calculation tools do not establish automated fixture design and construction here.
tasks.still_hard: Access, distortion, repeatability and actual fit require contextual evaluation.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when a nominal concept fails in the actual setup.
tasks.altitude: Fixture judgement and construction retain their full time.

reach.learn: How physical production constraints affect fixture design

evidence.claim: Devising and constructing a suitable fixture requires design judgement and physical work; no measured local automation saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is devising and building the fixture, excluding later repeated machine mounting, final engineering release and production. Shared fit checks with mounting are assigned once.

Responsible engineering supplies process requirements and actual parts before s1 closes. The setter establishes dimensions, constraints and concept during s1 and produces physical fit evidence during s2. All capture and checking remain retained. No free correct-part-geometry, viable-fixture or release-approved flag is assumed; unresolved design questions require qualified clarification before completion.
Existing tools and controlled references precede custom software. No new modeling system, transferred measurement or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual fixture design authority and review requirements
research_questions: Which fixture difficulties require additional design expertise rather than automated representation?
